info.title: iGOT Karmayogi - Platform APIs
info.description:
Derived from the iGOT docs (apis.md pages), the sunbird-devops Kong route map and the companion Postman collection. Paths use the Kong form `/api/...` unless noted; the browser form is `/apis/proxies/v8/...` via sunbird-cb-uiproxy.

Request bodies are minimal examples and responses are generic - NOT captured traffic. Schemas are intentionally loose (`type: object`) until verified per feature.

tags.name: 00 Health & Smoke (monitor-ready)
tags.description: Cheap, side-effect-free requests intended for Postman Monitors / blackbox parity. See MONITORING.md section 6.

tags.name: 01 Registration & Onboarding
tags.description: Public sign-up, department link/QR, SSO first login. Docs: learning-hub/user-onboarding.

tags.name: 04 Blended Program (workflow)
tags.description: Docs: learning-hub/blended-program. Approval route is data (system_settings), not code.

tags.name: 05 Content Authoring Lifecycle (knowledge-platform)
tags.description: Docs: platform/content-lifecycle. Draft->Review->Live->Retired. Publish is asynchronous.

tags.name: 06 Events Hub (event/v4, eventset/v4)
tags.description: Paths are as documented; Kong prefix for event/eventset is unconfirmed - verify against kong-api defaults.

tags.name: 07 Competency Hub
tags.description: Two taxonomies coexist (see ADR-016). FRAC paths go through /apis/protected/v8 directly to frac-backend.

tags.name: 09 Training Plan (CB Plan)
tags.description: Docs: learning-hub/training-plan. v1 is largely superseded by v2/v3.

tags.name: 10 Discussion Hub
tags.description: Paths from docs (base shown without service prefix); verify gateway prefix in Kong route map.

tags.name: 11 Marketplace (partners)
tags.description: Docs: learning-hub/marketplace. Service prefixes are not fully traced - treat as templates.

tags.name: 12 AI CBP Tool (cbp-ai-service)
tags.description: Base URL variable `cbp_ai_url` already includes any /api/v1 prefix if required - the documented health route is /api/v1/health.
